author: Ainfantozzi
quote: GTA VI is a huge disappointment after all these years in development. It’s baffling to me that the very same flaws for which other games face heavy criticism are simply excused here just because this was a highly anticipated title. The performance is terrible, and the sheer number of bugs that have surfaced is inexcusable—yet, most critics have still given it a perfect score of 100. The only notable aspects are the graphics and the aggressive marketing campaign designed to sell a game that, frankly, feels vastly overrated. It’s a real slap in the face to actual consumers—as opposed to those "critics" who were paid as part of that same marketing push to manufacture disproportionate hype.
